title: Multimodal Document QA
motto: The 2026 document-QA frontier moved away from OCR-then-text and toward vision-first late interaction. ColPali, ColQwen2.5, and ColQwen3-omni treat each PDF page as an image, embed it with multi-vector late interaction, and let the query attend to patches directly. On financial 10-Ks, scientific papers, and handwritten notes this pattern beats OCR-first by a large margin. Build the pipeline end to end on 10k pages and publish the side-by-side against OCR-then-text.
